title: Verification / Exception Record (VER)
description: Links to a previously issued Deletion Evidence Record (DER) and records later verification, residual-state discovery, exception, legal hold update, subprocessor completion, correction, or review. See /spec/deletion-evidence-record.md for the normative specification.

record_type.description: Fixed discriminator identifying this as a Verification / Exception Record.

linked_record_id.description: record_id of the parent DER this VER refers to.

linked_record_hash.description: The exact record_hash of the parent DER at the time this VER was created. Used to pin the linkage and detect tampering with the parent record.

verification_type.description: Free-text descriptor of what kind of verification/exception activity this record represents (e.g. 'periodic_review', 'subprocessor_confirmation', 'audit_spot_check', 'data_subject_follow_up').

residual_state_update.description: Updated declarative statement of residual state, if changed since the parent DER.

subprocessor_update.description: Updated declarative statement of subprocessor completion, if changed since the parent DER.

exception_reason.description: Required in substance (though not schema-enforced free text) whenever verification_status is EXCEPTION_IDENTIFIED or RESIDUAL_COPY_IDENTIFIED. Describes the nature of the exception.

recorded_by_reference.description: Opaque reference to the party recording this verification. Not a personal name.

record_hash.description: SHA-256 hash (lowercase hex) of this record's own canonicalized content, this field excluded.
